name: Glaucous-Almagest
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against acid rain regions, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Herds of six-limbed graziers shadow the meltwater margins, wary of anything that walks upright.
Around the signal of unknown origin, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
